name: roi_x_only_at_h055_sensitivity_b2000
description: Near-optimal prediction sensitivity analysis for ROI X-only paired VCTR coefficient functions.
notes: Sensitivity bandwidth h=0.55 is the smallest candidate within 1% of the selected-configuration best prediction RMSE.
ROI RMSE_std at h=0.55 is approximately 0.742% above the h=0.85 optimum for S=6x2x1, R=1.
Patients are sampled by manifest subject_id; all visits and both eyes are retained.
CP features, response transformation, and structural hyperparameters remain fixed.
